canonical_title: Piano Score Sheet with Pitch Alphabets Generator using Optical Music Recognition
abstract: For beginners who learn to play piano, recognizing the pitch alphabet of each music note and their position has always been handy stuff. That’s the main problem that we’re going to solve in this senior project I. In order to solve that problem, we are going to build a platform that end users can upload their sheets and then we will apply Haar-like feature to adopt to Optical Music Recognition process to print the pitch alphabet on top of each music note that is going to help the users be able to read the sheet music easily. For our senior project I, our system will be able to detect both PDF and digital image format of sheet music and convert them into some digital format printed upon each music note.

domain.label: Music and sheet reading
domain.evidence: The system prints the pitch alphabet of each note on piano sheet music to help beginners who have a hard time reading sheet music (Chapter 1 and Chapter 6).

abstract:
In our childhood, we grew up playing computer games. Computer game is the most common source of entertainment because it makes the player feel involved since they can interact with the game to achieve some goals of the game. Unlike watching movies or listening to music, with games players get the change of interacting and bring out their emotions while playing like killing, fighting, competing and many more. So, the concept of this project comes up with the games that remind us of our childhood. Therefore, we try to design a 2D game into 8 bit resolution like the old ones that we are familiar with. The story of the game is based on university life combine with some Sci-Fi theme.

To make our game fun and challenging we have different stages with different level of difficulty. The first stage is rather simple and easy so novice players can begin to play and get used to how to play. Once they move to next level it gets harder and more killing, jumping, being aware of the fire is required. We show the score on the screen to make it more interesting and keep count of the score by increasing the number of the score as the player kills a monster and collect the scores until the player dies or reaches the end of level.

We hope our game can make people enjoy playing and find the challenges interesting and want to play more.

canonical_title: Low Cost RFID Laundry Management System
abstract: Small laundry shops identify, check, and record customer orders manually, which is slow and error prone for owners with limited budget, manpower, and technology knowledge. The project built a low cost RFID laundry management system that maps the RFID tag of a washing bag to a customer's telephone number or email together with the order details. Staff use an Angular web application to add customers, add orders, and update order status, and an Android application written in Kotlin lets the owner track and update orders on a phone. Data is stored in a Firebase NoSQL database and Firebase Cloud Functions send an automatic email notification when an order is ready to pick up. Interviews showed the application helps with tracking orders, identifying orders, notifying customers, and calculating profit, and the low frequency RFID option was chosen because it fit the users' limited budget.

canonical_title: A Case Study of the Indoor Performance of Bluetooth Smart with Raspberry Pi
aliases: A Case Study of the Indoor Performance of Bluetooth Smart with Raspberry Pi 3
advisor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Dobri Atanassov Batovski
abstract: This project deals with the results of an experimental study of the indoor transmission performance of Bluetooth low energy (BLE, also known as Bluetooth Smart) using Raspberry Pi 3 and Raspberry Pi Zero W. The l2ping link layer tool is used to send multiple consecutive packets between two connected Bluetooth devices in order to study how the transmission latency varies with the increase of the distance between said devices in corridor and room configurations. Packets of two different sizes, 44 bytes and 200 bytes, are chosen for the transmission experiments. Experimental results with the use of power banks are also obtained.

domain.evidence: The whole study measures BLE transmission latency and RSSI indoors, and the degree earned is 'Bachelor of Science in Telecommunications Science'.
